title: alchemilla vulgaris var. demissa
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris var. demissa, commonly known as a variety of the Lady's Mantle plant, is a flowering perennial plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues such as menstrual cramps, wounds, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Alchemilla vulgaris var. demissa include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which help in soothing and protecting the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antioxidant activity.
